policy: Authenticated EXECUTE is intentional only for application RPCs whose function body performs explicit authorization. Anonymous EXECUTE must remain disabled for public SECURITY DEFINER functions.

review.search_path: every public SECURITY DEFINER function must define an explicit non-public search_path
required_evidence: isolated cross-facility regression for patient-scoped workflows

transitions.accepted_pending_function_specific_revie: no blanket revoke or invoker conversion; review by function
transitions.enforced: reviewed plus applicable isolation regression evidence
